note: Real Console framebuffer. The temporary Editor helper observes the opt-in RPC trace, clears Console just before the first C call, and captures after all 20 C calls have completed and before validating the next ordinary request. Tick senders, server validation, counter and logs are unchanged; later ordinary rejects remain in raw logs. The Console is repainted synchronously before reading pixels.
